title: Cyberwave Pose
description: Where a body is and which way it faces, in a frame the enclosing contract names: a position in metres and an orientation as a quaternion. The same six numbers as protobuf geometry.v1.Pose (`position`, `orientation`) and as the Pose in cyberwave-robot-format and the Python SDK. A pose locates one body in one frame; a transform relating two frames uses `translation` and `rotation`.
